text:
Situation: Insulin glulisine is not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 268 syringes at 10.1 per day for 26.6 days on hand. Corvale General holds 277 syringes at 12.1 per day for 23 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 60 syringes at 2.3 per day for 25.6 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): The product label identifies Sanofi-Aventis Deutschland GmbH (FEI 3003195501) as the manufacturing plant for NDC 00088250205. FDA inspection records for that plant show a VAI classification on 2022-03-25 and an OAI classification on 2010-09-16 with a Warning Letter issued 2011-02-08.

Our position: No national shortage exists. Site-level days on hand range from 23 to 26.6 days. The registered plant has a recent VAI inspection outcome. Supplier allocation status and any recent FDA actions affecting the plant are unconfirmed.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to contact the supplier to verify current allocation status and confirm supply continuity; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to query FDA databases for any inspection or regulatory actions at FEI 3003195501 after 2022-03-25; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Inventory team to monitor daily burn rates at all three sites and report if any site falls below 21 days on hand; requires Pharmacy Director approval.

Not recommended: Initiating therapeutic interchange protocols or restricting formulary access at this time.
